title: Starfish have EYES on their ARMS?! ⭐ #shorts
description:
Gizmo Jr. thinks he has the best eyes ever… wrong again. 🤖
Fizzo brought three animal facts that sound fake but are 100% true. ⚡

Which one got you? Comment below! 👇
Follow for a new mind-blowing fact every day!

#facts #funfacts #didyouknow #animals #shorts
facts_checked: Many starfish (sea stars) have a simple eye at the tip of each arm, which they use to see their surroundings and find their way home (Proc. R. Soc. B, 2014).
Flamingos are pink because of carotenoid pigments in the algae and small shrimp-like animals they eat; without them they fade to a pale color.
Axolotls can regrow a whole lost leg (and even parts of their heart and spinal cord) without scarring.
